videos.title: High Taste Testers: OpenAI Shipped Everything. What Actually Works?
videos.description:
Six AI power users compare what actually works—and what falls apart once you start using it.
Ben Davis, Ben Hylak, Dex Horthy, Allison Durham, Alex Volkov, and swyx discuss OpenAI DevDay, coding agents, personal assistants, model preferences, and the gap between impressive AI capabilities and useful products.

From Pi-powered personal agents and decision models to subagents, context management, prompt injection, and assistants that can spend money: what deserves a place in your daily workflow?


CHAPTERS
00:00 High Taste Testers
01:26 OpenAI DevDay: Dots, Spaces, and product execution
10:28 Great models versus great products
14:39 Agents versus assistants
18:08 Building a personal assistant with Pi
21:07 Decision models, Jev, and predictive interfaces
32:46 Model speed, writing quality, and subagents
37:29 Agent loops, forks, and context management
43:19 Haiku, Muse Spark, and Grok
50:00 Local models and coding benchmarks
54:09 Prompt injection and assistants taking action
57:50 Tools, payments, and assistant overload
1:02:16 Delegation, computer use, and everyday workflows
1:10:48 AI hardware and closing thoughts
